responsibility: Implements GCC’s generic tree-level type-conversion routines used by front ends and middle-end expression builders. It owns the semantics for converting between integer, pointer/reference, real, complex, fixed-point, and vector types, deciding which tree codes to build (such as NOP_EXPR, CONVERT_EXPR, FIXED_CONVERT_EXPR, VIEW_CONVERT_EXPR, or ADDR_SPACE_CONVERT_EXPR), when conversions may be folded immediately, and when diagnostics should be issued for invalid source categories. The file also preserves source-location wrappers across folded constants, performs some canonicalization and builtin-specific floating conversion rewrites, and contains selftests that verify stable conversion behavior.
same_name_distinction: Implements the conversion entry points declared in gcc/convert.h, deciding which tree conversion nodes to build, when to fold them, and when to diagnose invalid conversions across scalar, pointer, complex, fixed-point, and vector cases; unlike the header, it contains the conversion semantics and selftests.
